indicator_name: Average retail prices of petrol, diesel and LPG by city, monthly, KZT
description: Средние цены на бензин, дизельное топливо и сжиженный газ по городам, помесячно, тенге
unit: KZT per litre (petrol, diesel), per 50-litre cylinder or per kg (LPG)
methodology: Taldau 703115 «Цены на продукты нефтепереработки» and 703114 (LPG), BNS price registration in 21 cities (region column as HOUSING_PRICE_INDEX_BY_CITY). Petrol from 2011-01, diesel from 2014-01 (winter diesel seasonal and sparse). National AI-92: 2011-01 90, 2026-01 236, 2026-06 240; AI-95 2026-06 313; summer diesel 2026-06 336. Autogas per litre and weekly prices are not published.
